notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Google Dork targeting AWS S3 bucket URLs using inurl: and intext: operators. Google indexes publicly accessible S3 content — documents, configs, and code stored without access controls appear in search results. Entirely passive from the target's perspective.

=== CHAINING ===
Run dork → identify S3 bucket names → check bucket with aws s3 ls s3://bucket-name --no-sign-request (unauthenticated) → if accessible: look for id_rsa, config files, credentials, source code.

=== CRITICAL FINDING ===
SSH private keys (id_rsa) in S3 buckets are critical severity findings — direct SSH access to internal systems with no auth required. Credentials in config files provide immediate access to other services.
